tools.title: Mortgage Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Work out your monthly mortgage repayment from the property price, deposit, interest rate and term. Includes overpayments and total interest.

tools.title: Mortgage Comparison Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Compare two or three mortgage deals side by side, including fees, to see which is genuinely cheapest rather than which has the lowest monthly payment.

tools.title: Mortgage Overpayment Calculator
tools.metaDescription: See how much interest you save and how many years you cut off your mortgage by overpaying monthly or with a lump sum.

tools.title: Stamp Duty Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Calculate UK stamp duty land tax on a property purchase, including the first-time buyer and additional property rates.

tools.title: Take-Home Pay Calculator
tools.metaDescription: Work out your salary after income tax, National Insurance and pension contributions.

tools.title: Compound Interest Calculator
tools.metaDescription: See how savings grow over time with compound interest and regular monthly contributions.

tools.title: Word Unscrambler
tools.metaDescription: Unscramble letters into every valid word they can make, from short two-letter words up to the full jumble. Free, instant, no sign-up.

tools.title: Anagram Solver
tools.metaDescription: Find every anagram of a set of letters, plus every shorter word hidden inside them. Free, instant, no sign-up.

tools.title: Words Starting With
tools.h1: Words Starting, Ending or Containing Letters
tools.metaDescription: Find dictionary words that start with, end with or contain a set of letters, with an optional exact-length filter.

tools.title: Scrabble Word Finder
tools.metaDescription: Find the highest-scoring Scrabble words from your tiles, with letter values worked out for you.

tools.title: Words With Friends Cheat
tools.metaDescription: Find the best-scoring Words With Friends plays from your letters, using the Words With Friends dictionary and tile values.

tools.title: Word Counter
tools.metaDescription: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with reading time and speaking time estimates.

tools.title: Case Converter
tools.metaDescription: Convert text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case and more, instantly.

tools.title: Text Diff Checker
tools.metaDescription: Compare two blocks of text and see exactly what changed, line by line and word by word.

tools.title: Duplicate Line Remover
tools.metaDescription: Remove duplicate lines from a list or block of text, with options to ignore case and trim whitespace.

tools.title: Remove Extra Spaces
tools.metaDescription: Strip extra spaces, tabs and blank lines from text, ready to paste somewhere clean.

tools.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator
tools.metaDescription: Generate placeholder Lorem Ipsum text by paragraphs, sentences or words, for mockups and layouts.

tools.title: Text Reverser
tools.metaDescription: Reverse text letter by letter, word by word, or line by line.

tools.title: Merge PDF
tools.metaDescription: Combine several PDFs into one file, in any order you choose. Runs in your browser — your files are never uploaded.

tools.title: Split PDF
tools.metaDescription: Pull selected pages out of a PDF into a new file. Choose single pages or ranges. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Delete PDF Pages
tools.metaDescription: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF and download the trimmed file. Runs entirely in your browser.

tools.title: Rotate PDF
tools.metaDescription: Turn sideways or upside-down PDF pages the right way up, individually or all at once. No upload needed.

tools.title: Reorder PDF Pages
tools.metaDescription: Rearrange the pages of a PDF into any order you like and download the result. Processed on your device.

tools.title: Images to PDF
tools.metaDescription: Turn JPG and PNG images into a single PDF, one image per page, with page size and margin options.

tools.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF
tools.h1: Add Page Numbers to a PDF
tools.metaDescription: Add page numbers to a PDF in the position and format you want, with the option to skip a cover page.

tools.title: Watermark PDF
tools.h1: Add a Watermark to a PDF
tools.metaDescription: Stamp text such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL across every page of a PDF, with adjustable opacity and angle.
